agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Capture oracle selected certified Absorb, but each embedded battle-step prediction recommended switching to Lildozer; align capture and generic tactical certificates before relying on prediction fields.
Bushtank took 24 HP of poison residual and enemy damage while weakening; no safer legal alternative was replay-verified, so this is a measured risk rather than a proven suboptimal action.
Three certified actions and one Poké Ball were used; the final throw occurred at 10/29 HP with no status multiplier available.

correct_choices: ROM encounter lookup and bounded hunt found the exact species without screenshot inference.
Absorb was used only while its critical-hit ceiling was nonlethal.
The helper stopped weakening at 10/29 HP and threw with L, then applied the required nickname Ohmnomnom.
agent_review.next_test: Make capture_target pass its selected action into battle-step prediction so the certificate has one consistent decision.
